title: CrestApps AI Documents configuration
description: Limits of chat session document uploads, read from appsettings.json in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

MaxFilesPerSession.description: How many documents one chat session may hold.

AttemptPolicies.description: Overrides of attempt policies by name. This module registers ai-chat-document-sessions: the upload sessions a signed-in user may start (30 an hour by default). Only the values given change.

PermitLimit.description: How many attempts a key may have in a window. 0 turns the policy off.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 01:00:00.

BlockDuration.description: How long a key that reached the limit with failures stays blocked, as a time span such as 00:30:00. Empty or 00:00:00 for none.

ResetOnSuccess.description: Whether a success clears the key's counter.
